cases.note: A store without #_version_# is read under version 1.
A version-1 reader applies version 1 to lines declared version 3, so version-1 markers still work.
A store may switch versions 2, 1 and back to the default; every row is still read.

#_version_#	2
a	x
#_version_#	1

#_version_#
